top_signals.title: El Nino-powered drought leaves Indonesian palm farmers high and dry as river recedes
top_signals.summary: Palm oil mills accounting for roughly half of West Kalimantan province's processing capacity have been affected by the transportation disruptions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: JICA and the World Bank should put the poor first
top_signals.summary: Poor people are vulnerable to everything — disease, hunger, broken infrastructure and economic shocks. The question is will climate policy help them.
